## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue when available.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their outcomes. Include any remaining limits.

- [ ] Canonical source, package exports, registry and docs agree where affected.
- [ ] Light/dark modes, mobile layout and keyboard behavior were reviewed where affected.
- [ ] Examples are complete and copied source was tested where affected.
- [ ] Assets and adapted source retain their license and credit.
- [ ] No credentials, local settings or generated test artifacts are included.

Include screenshots for intentional visual changes. Do not replace failing checks with an unverified success claim.
